aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed IF construct and SELECT CASE source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_115.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 248 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. authored_facets remains 1788, the fixture review states remain 1770 reference-validated, 274 source-reviewed and 1 needs-oracle, and the tests directory is untouched. Only 17 of the 39 scoped base units are newly accounted, because 22 numbered items were already counted; the asymmetry that numbered items fall only in 11.1.8.1, 11.1.8.4 and 11.1.9.1 and none in the execution or examples subclauses was independently confirmed. 95 new facets remain pending. The authoring prompt deliberately did not name the constructs; the author established them from the source and the reviewer verified the titles independently. The SELECT CASE matching rules were derived independently from the source before comparison, covering which ranges match which selector values, that at most one block is selected, how ranges with an omitted bound behave, and when CASE DEFAULT is selected. The character selector trap was examined specifically: C1152 allows differing character lengths while comparison blank-pads the shorter operand, so a length-differing match is meaningful but a plan relying on that accidentally would prove nothing; the packet states the semantics explicitly and assumes no particular character kind. Four permissions were adjudicated. The END IF and END SELECT only-from-within sentences carry both a permission and a paired restriction, and both halves are captured. The 11.1.8.4 p3 side-effect permission was accepted with an explicit double-credit caution, since 10.1.4 owns general evaluation latitude and side effects. The C1152 character-length-difference permission was examined for whether it is a genuine permission or merely an absent restriction, which would be a classification error, and accepted as an explicit permission. The attribution audit covered the R1137, R1141, R1146 and R1149 rows whose prohibiting words are grammar productions rather than a shall, the four C1147 and three C1149 construct-name rows, and the three C1154 rows that all cite the identical no-possible-value-matches-more-than-one-range clause, with the character-padding overlap row checked as not rejectable for a second reason. Observability discipline was verified: which block executed is plainly observable while which condition or selector was evaluated is not, and Fortran guarantees no short-circuiting; the plans assert only which block ran using sentinels distinct from every value any block could write, and the unobservability claim is scoped so it does not suppress the block-selection fact. 11.1.8.3 and 11.1.9.3 yield zero facets because they are examples. No IF or SELECT CASE execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
